lettering: METR’s final analysis uses approximately 1,300 overlapping agent transcripts containing raw reasoning and actions. Most are very long, often millions of tokens. A token is a text-processing unit; it is not one action, message, transcript or independently reviewed claim.

detail_decisions.reason: Retain scale with correct units, overlapping selection sets, non-prefix examination and reconstructed clocks. Six on-site days are not the total elapsed work, and practical AI dependence does not certify every interpretation.
